title: Mechanical All-Seeing Eye
description: A massive, intricately detailed mechanical eye dominates the frame, its iris replaced by a glowing pyramid with a staircase leading into purple light. The eye is framed by heavy metallic plates, bolts, and pipes, with white smoke drifting around it. The background shows a dramatic night sky with aurora borealis, stars, and a crescent moon above a ground scattered with skulls and crystals.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a gigantic mechanical eye with intricate metal casing, bolts, and pipes. The iris contains a glowing purple pyramid with a staircase ascending into it. White ethereal smoke swirls around the eye. The background features a dramatic night sky with vibrant green and purple aurora borealis, stars, and a crescent moon. Skulls and crystals are scattered on the dark ground below, dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
